# freshdesk_time_entry (Resource)

Time logged by an agent against a ticket.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ticket_id` (Number) ID of the ticket the time is logged against. Changing it forces a new entry.

### Optional

- `agent_id` (Number) ID of the agent the time is logged for.
- `billable` (Boolean) Whether the time is chargeable to the customer.
- `executed_at` (String) When the work was done (RFC 3339), for backdating.
- `note` (String) Description of the work done.
- `start_time` (String) When the timer was started (RFC 3339).
- `time_spent` (String) Duration as `HH:MM`, for example `01:30`.
- `timer_running` (Boolean) Whether the entry's timer is currently counting.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the time entry was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the time entry.
- `updated_at` (String) When the time entry was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import freshdesk_time_entry.example 42
```
